resources.string: Can\'t reach J.A.S.S.I. Check your internet.
Lets J.A.S.S.I see and tap your screen when you ask it to do something in another app.

When you ask J.A.S.S.I to do something in another app, it reads what is on your screen as text and taps, types and scrolls for you.

It never opens or reads banking, payment, ID, password or health-record apps. It never reads or types passwords. It does not act on Settings, permission or install screens. It takes no screenshots, and nothing it reads is saved on this phone.

What it reads is sent to the J.A.S.S.I server to work out the next step.

While it is working you see “J.A.S.S.I is working · Stop” at the top of the screen. Touch the screen or tap Stop and it stops at once. You can switch this off here at any time.
